services.name: OKC Haunted History Tours
services.desc: Special narrated haunted history tours created in cooperation with Preservation Oklahoma, Incorporated. For every Friday night OKC Haunted History tour ticket sold, Water Taxi will make a $2 donation to Preservation Oklahoma, Inc. For every ticket sold for our the very special October 25 outing with guest storyteller Chantry Banks, Executive Director of Preservation Oklahoma and the Henry and Anna Overholser Mansion, Preservation Oklahoma will receive a $5 donation (10/25 price includes $2 ticket upcharge). POK is the state's only private, nonprofit membership organization that is dedicated Benefitting Preservation Oklahoma · BUY NOW!

services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: $350 for up to 30 guests --- Charters give your party exclusive use of a Water Taxi. Each boats hold up to 30 people, all charters are for 1 hour (including loading and unloading) and cost $350.00 plus tax, if applicable. With each chartered boat one of our very knowledgeable ambassadors will take you and your party along the full length of the Bricktown Canal and entertain you with his or her own personal tour including some historical information about Bricktown and Oklahoma City and lots of other fun facts about the area. With a chartered boat you can choose to pick up the boat at Most groups $350 plus tax · Up to 30 guests per boat · Tax exempt, school & daycare rates available
